184-4094-4682.easyPrerequisites:
At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
You have at least three opponents.
184-4094-4682.notablePrerequisites: Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
184-4094-4682.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least six Treasure tokens due to Kaya, Geist Hunter.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

1339-3394-4247.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3394-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

728-4871-5220-5651.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
728-4871-5220-5651.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

4017-4659-5086-5183-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4017-4659-5086-5183-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

109-7683.notablePrerequisites: You have another instant or sorcery card in hand with the mana to cast it and applicable target(s) if needed.
109-7683.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Fork's storm ability triggers, creating at least one copy of Fork targeting the original Fork.
Resolve a copy of Fork, copying Fork targeting the original Fork.
Repeat step 4.

141-7506.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
141-7506.description:
Cast Replicate by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Replicate, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Replicate, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

406-1339-7278.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
406-1339-7278.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Slash, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Tandem Lookout triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7338.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Putrid Pals.
When Putrid Pals dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2034-4094-5220-6351-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4094-5220-6351-6961.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Teval triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat from step 2

1374-3626-5499-7175--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1374-3626-5499-7175--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

1978-3088-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
1978-3088-7013.description:
Animate White Lotus Tile using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat from step 2.

586-5256-5258-5618-6747.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3918-4038-5139.description:
Activate Trazyn using Relic of Sauron's ability by tapping it, adding two in any combination of {U}, {B} or {R}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

539-2034-5003-6662.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashaya, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashaya dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ashaya enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
539-2034-5003-6662.notes: If you control a nontoken creature that has haste, you may instead sacrifice it, and then tap it each iteration to get infinite green mana and colorless mana.

643-1308-3951-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
643-1308-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

602-3591-5636-6282.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding a card.
Necropotence and Feast of Sanity trigger.
Resolve the Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Necropotence trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Repeat.

1350-1770-6470.description:
Cast Iridescent Tiger by paying {4}{R}.
When Iridescent Tiger enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Iridescent Tiger from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-1879-2511.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1879-2511.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

222-527-2438-4359.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2438-4359.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2713-3719-4865-5326.notablePrerequisites: Vesuvan Shapeshifter has a power of at least 2.
2713-3719-4865-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Vesuvan Shapeshifter and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Vesuvan Shapeshifter from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Vesuvan Shapeshifter to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Vesuvan Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Vesuvan Shapeshifter by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1365-1379-4659-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1379-4659-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Repeat.

877-2921-4254-4484.notablePrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
"Zombie" chosen with Morophon.
877-2921-4254-4484.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ebondeath, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat.

215-4231-4365-5444.description:
Cast Carnage Interpreter by paying {1}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Carnage Interpreter enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating eight Clue, Food and Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B/R}{B/R}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Carnage Interpreter to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

678-2366-2882-3819-4050.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cultivator Colossus.
678-2366-2882-3819-4050.description:
Play Dryad Arbor from your hand.
Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield as a copy of Cultivator Colossus due to Infinite Reflection.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding one mana of any color.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Dryad Arbor to your hand.
Resolve the Dryad Arbor trigger from step 3, causing you to put Dryad Arbor onto the battlefield from your hand, draw a card, and then decline to put another land onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

864-1465-2034-4871.description:
Cast Sevinne's Reclamation by paying {2}{W}, returning Eternal Witness to the battlefield.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Sevinne's Reclamation from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

45-1518-1987-3227.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
45-1518-1987-3227.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
